name: Epsilon Indi B
description: Preprocessed SPHEREx exposures from NASA/IPAC IRSA. SkyShift processing: common north-up grid, zodiacal/background subtraction and per-detector display stretch. Wavelengths vary between visits; inspect the original FITS before interpreting motion or brightness.
processing_note: SkyShift also fills small missing-pixel holes for display and upsamples the previews. These PNGs are visual aids. Original FITS were not independently downloaded or revalidated during this import.
